description: This PHP source file defines a controller class for the Opencart admin panel that manages the customer search report. It includes methods for displaying the report interface, saving report settings, and retrieving search data with filtering and pagination.

classes.name: CustomerSearch
classes.description: Controller class for managing the customer search report in OpenCart admin.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Displays the customer search report page with breadcrumb navigation and report configuration options.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the report settings via AJAX, with permission check and JSON response.

methods.name: report
methods.description: Loads and renders the customer search report data for display.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Returns the customer search report list, typically for AJAX updates.

methods.name: getReport
methods.description: Retrieves filtered customer search data, handles pagination, and returns the report view.
